newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices steady in range-bound trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices steady in range-bound trade.

text.p: Indian cotton prices were steady on Friday, maintaining gains recorded on Thursday, dealers said. They had risen on Thursday on news that the Indian government had allowed export of an additional 400,000 bales (170 kg each).

In spot deals Bengal-deshi was steady at 835/860 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned was 1,390/1,630 rupees per maund. Gujarat Sankar-4 (long-staple) remained steady at 18,000/18,500 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
Millers said they were opposed to the government's decision to allow increased exports. "We have requested the government to reconsider and not to allow more export," one miller said.
